scope: Entire existing public catalogue; not a claim of completed historical coverage.

policy.sourceMinimum: One reasonable linked source per added fact; no invented values.
policy.waves: Czech fleet >=1000, then 1–999, then absent/unknown fleet.
policy.noFleetMeaning: Missing/unknown fleet is not asserted to be zero.
policy.technicalVersions: Main documented engine families; no gearbox combination expansion.
policy.equipment: Only continue equipment research when already started.
